text:
The packet is a proposed, specified-only B01–B04 identity design. It contains no authenticated implementation, no executed verifier or consumer, and no W-D2, W-D3, B01–B17, or Sprint 1 closure. One medium first-failure contradiction remains. No high defect is present in the embedded bytes.

## Evidence limits

This review uses only the embedded packet. Manifest SHA-256 values were not recomputed. RESULT.md statements about git HEAD, `history/pre-grok-repair-*`, CLI status, and graphify were not checked. No Source, wire, registry, or fixture byte was executed. G21 and G50 are hypothetical non-rejections under assumed proofs. A separate GPT-6.1 pass was not run in this review.

## Prior three mediums

Those three gaps are repaired in this text.

- The baseline now carries Source `selected.sourceHash` / `policyDigest`, wire `sourceHash` / `coreHash` / `policyHash`, and conditional `expectedArtifactHashes`. G51–G53 are numbered genuine-artifact hash mismatches, distinct from G38–G40’s wrong-image `EVIDENCE_INVALID` rows. Core has no invented `coreHash` claim.
- `source.intent.preHead` and `source.authenticated.head` are both `5`×64. G12 and G46–G48 require both tag18 Source literals to pass before the B11 result.
- G03 is rejection only. Numbered positives are G21 and G50. G01–G53 are 53 rows: those two identity-only controls and 51 rejection/control rows.

## What holds

The five nominal sorts are `AgreementInstanceId`, `StageId`, `EpisodeId`, `ActionId`, and `CoreProgramId`. Domain stays the existing carrier. That split matches the embedded Source AST, lowerer (`programId = selected.actionId`), Core builtin/kind checks, wire tags 3/4/5/6/10, and the effect image, which has no agreement, stage, episode, action, or Core-program id. Source/6 still has no stage or episode slot. The wrapper is an adapter claim. `Action` remains an equality-fixture label; G16 rejects it under A, and G17’s wrong Source builtin is `SOURCE6_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED` before D/M.

Mapping A keeps the W-D2F tag6 action literal and the two S0 triples. Mapping B is an unadopted alternative that needs a successor contract because today’s tag6 literal would reject `Action` before any alias lookup.

B11 head custody matches current FIELD-MAP/PLAN. B02 retains a stage-association reference and does not compare `preHead`. Tag18 order is intent `preHead`, then `authenticated.head`, then B11 integrity (including the proposed registry/stage-to-snapshot link), then core, domain, asset, then signed `preHead`. G12 is `BINDING_UNAVAILABLE/B11`. G46 and G48 are `EVIDENCE_INVALID/B11`. G47 is `FIELD_MISMATCH/preHead` with binding B11, `factPath=B11.snapshot.head`, and `sourcePath=null`.

Forward checks that have isolating rows match the stated order: G32 at tag4, G33 and G49 at tag5, G34 at tag6 through B01 action membership, G35/G18/G42 at tag10, G36 at tag16, G41 at tag35. D wire-only failures G24 and G26 use `sourcePath=null` and `inputPath=wire.stageId`. Present-wrapper D failures G43–G45 use `sourcePath=context.stageId` or `context.episodeId` and run before the wire counterpart. That wrapper path is stated as a proposed extension.

G21 stops before B05 and claims no tag10 or tag16 positive. Equal text still supplies no registry (G01). A `CoreProgramId` record does not satisfy B01 (G03).

## Medium

SPEC tag6 step 4 compares the current `actionId` to B04’s retained current-action fact and stops at the first failure. The same section says a genuine different provider fact mismatches at that field’s own comparison point, and it withholds only signed `coreProgramId` and operation kind at tag6. FIELD-MAP anchors current `actionId` on B04 at tag6 and keeps Core id, images, and constructor for tags 10/8/11/12/35.

G29 leaves the action key and the wire action as `TransferLiteralFee`, changes `selectedTarget` to `[RepayAccrualFirst, RepayAccrualFirst, repayment]`, and still expects B04 to succeed at tag6. Its first failure is `FIELD_MISMATCH/coreProgramId` at tag10. The G18+G29 paragraph repeats that tag10 locus. Under the SPEC order, the retained action component differs from the current action and fails at tag6 as `actionId`, before tag10 and before the constructor difference G29 treats as the next difference.

G42 is consistent with that order because only the Core-program component changes. G29 changes the action component as well and schedules it as a tag10 Core-program failure. An implementer cannot get one first-failure field from both texts. The G29 vector still rejects on the later Core-program difference; the defect is the gate and the field, and it does not adopt a positive.

## Residual notes

These stay below medium. Tag5’s final “current B03 episode fact” is not in the B03 retain list and has no isolating row. G51–G53 name the binding and the authentic hash; they do not spell `factPath` and `sourcePath` the way G47 does for the head. The mapping-B structural bullet still calls one alias key a valid relation control. That sentence is outside the 53 and outside recommended A.
